name: Dreamtune
description: Access model requests, tool APIs, GPU jobs and request traces through a scoped workspace key; paid operations use workspace credit and the key's permissions.

inputs.label: Dreamtune workspace API key
inputs.description: Your production workspace key with only the model, tool or compute permissions you need. Paid operations require workspace credit.

obtain.instructions:
1. Sign in to Dreamtune and select your workspace.
2. Create a production API key with the model, tool or compute scopes you need and appropriate spending limits.
3. Copy the key into this protected field.
4. Add workspace credit before paid operations.

auth.instructions: Supply your workspace key through the X-Dreamtune-API-Key header. The hosted server does not use browser OAuth.
